description:
## Problem (reproduced; published)
`_duckdb_sort_index_sql` (`benchbox/platforms/duckdb.py:147-156`) and the cluster-index builder (`duckdb.py:~1438`) emit `CREATE INDEX … ON LINEITEM (L_ORDERKEY, …)` against tables created as quoted lowercase. DuckDB 1.5.5 then stores `duckdb_indexes().expressions = ['(LINEITEM.L_ORDERKEY)', …]`. A case-exact reference stores `[l_orderkey]`.

The receipt reports a false `mismatch` for every index on every DuckDB tuned run. A sort-only, constraint-free custom config proved this is the sole blocker. All 5 published DuckDB tuned bundles carry these false mismatches.

The cited test (`tests/unit/platforms/test_duckdb_introspection.py:209-241`) passes only because it creates an **unquoted uppercase** table that production never creates. The doc claim at `docs/development/tuning-introspection-receipts.md:145-157` is false.

## Change
- Emit index DDL with the physical identifiers from `tuning-physical-identifier-resolution-20261001`, quoted, e.g. `"lineitem" ("l_orderkey", …)`.
- Replace the unquoted fixture with one built by the real `DuckDBAdapter.create_schema`.
- Make the receipt `diff` text explicit when the catalog shows a bound expression: "catalog stored a bound expression; identifier case in the DDL differs from the catalog".
- Fix the doc paragraph.
- **DuckLake:** check whether `CREATE INDEX` is supported. If not, record a drop rather than a failure, and detach the DuckDB introspector from DuckLake until it is.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- **Do not change `normalize_columns`** (plan review F5). Unwrapping bound forms would relax the match rule, and it cannot be table-scoped there.
- A bound-form fact must still produce `mismatch`.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
